remediation.reason: Re-review failed: index flags and core.worktree hide uncommitted product changes; rename detection hides deletions

findings.summary: Verified fixed: replace refs (loose or packed) and grafts raise eval-history-rewritten; no regressions.

After a legitimate empty-implement SDD through close, an uncommitted product change hidden by skip-worktree, assume-unchanged plus info/exclude, or core.worktree pointing elsewhere is invisible to git status and graded compliant while the functional grade reads it from disk. Make the uncommitted check independent of agent-controlled index flags and config, with tests.
windowIssues uses git diff --name-only with rename detection, so moving a product file into a bookkeeping path outside implement hides the product deletion. Use --no-renames.

Alternates cannot substitute content-addressed objects; grader env is runner-controlled; a patched git or host tampering subverts the tooling itself and belongs to sandbox isolation, the same class as L1.
A fully forged certification chain or subverted host git tooling cannot be proven locally; documented, consistent with the README authorship caveat.
